description_short: Keeps tower vehicle-assignment menus usable with large modded vehicle catalogs.
description_long:
**ADAPTIVE MINING TOWER UI**
Prevents large modded vehicle catalog from clipping out of view and become impossible to select in the Mining Tower's UI.
Set 1-8 visible rows for each vehicle section. When more vehicles are available than fit within that limit, a vertical scrollbar appears automatically.
Excavator and truck sections can also be collapsed.
No save data is added. The mod can be added to or removed from an existing save.

The layout works from the shared tower assignment component, allowing modded vehicle to appear without per-vehicle patches.
